it's mutually convenient. I look forward to talking with you.

Best,
Jonathan

messages.body:
Hi Kleopatra,

I think you may have meant to copy my son Jonathan on this. I’ve copied him on this email. I separately proposed talking to Doug on the 26th between 10-12 PT (1-3 ET). If the 2:30-3 ET time slot is still open, that would be perfect.

Thanks

Grace – I appreciate your quick response. Here are some times (ET) that
work for me this week and early next week.

Wednesday (1/31): 12:30 pm - 2:30 pm & 4 pm onwards
Thursday (2/1): 11:30 am - 2:30 pm & 6 pm onwards
Friday (2/2): 3:30 pm onwards
Monday (1/5): 12:30 pm onwards
Tuesday (1/6): 11:30 am - 2:30 pm & 6 pm onwards

Please let me know if any of these times are convenient for you. I look
forward to speaking soon.

Best,
Jonathan

Hey Jonathan – think you’re setting up some time with Grace, so will let you connect with her first and then hopefully with other people in the group.

If you run out of people to talk with, I can always help facilitate.

Best,
Jay

Jay Klein | BARCLAYS
Investment Banking | Global Technology Group

745 Seventh Avenue | New York, NY 10019

Hello Jay,

I hope you are doing well. I am reaching out to you directly following the introduction Doug made on my behalf. To briefly introduce myself, I am a sophomore Economics and Business Student at the University of Texas, Austin. I am interested in pursuing Tech Banking in NY, and would love to speak with you to learn a little more about your experience at Barclays.

It would be great to connect either later this week or early next week. Please let me know if you would be willing to chat. Attached is my resume.

Best,
Jonathan

Jonathan, it was great speaking with you last week. As a next step, I’d like to introduce my colleagues Grace Steelman and Jay Klein (copied). Both are relatively new to Barclays and can help you navigate the analyst experience, either speaking with them directly, or to some of our other colleagues in the technology team.

Will let you guys take it from here, but as I mentioned, happy to speak again any time as you move through the process and need some advice. Either way, you’ll be in good hands.

Doug

Thank you for sending along you availability. Do you have flexibility on Wednesday or Thursday next week?

Best,
Grace

Grace – I appreciate your quick response. Here are some times (ET) that work for me this week and early next week.

Wednesday (1/31): 12:30 pm - 2:30 pm & 4 pm onwards
Thursday (2/1): 11:30 am - 2:30 pm & 6 pm onwards
Friday (2/2): 3:30 pm onwards
Monday (1/5): 12:30 pm onwards
Tuesday (1/6): 11:30 am - 2:30 pm & 6 pm onwards

Jonathan

messages.subject: Re: Potential favor
messages.body:
Hello Grace,

I wanted to thank you for spending the time with me today over the phone to
talk about your recruitment process and your experience at Barclays New
York. I am very appreciative of your willingness to offer insight as I am
still navigating this process and determining what I am looking for. To
that end, I looked on LinkedIn for the name of the Barclays MD who is a
Texas alum, but realized he is in the Houston office. However, I was able
to find an analyst in New York from UT Austin. His name is Jesse Chou. If
you can use your internal database and send over his email that would be
much appreciated. Thanks again!

Best,
Jonathan
